summary: SENTIENT UX FORK — backend-only contract validated. 30/30 pytest cases GREEN (test_iter30_sentient_ux.py). PrefIn now correctly accepts birth_year (1900..2030 range enforced — 1800→400, 2100→400, 2000→200, 1958→200), biometric_enabled and wake_word_enabled — all three persist and are echoed by GET /api/auth/me. Partial-update semantics preserved: PATCH {biometric_enabled:false} does not clobber wake_word_enabled or birth_year (fields with None are skipped in update_prefs upd dict). Unauth PATCH → 401. TTS: POST /api/voice/tts with voice='onyx' + speed=0.95 accepted for all 14 languages (sk, cs, en, de, fr, es, it, pl, hu, uk, ru, pt, nl, ro) → 200 with deterministic key+url; GET /api/voice/tts/{key}.mp3 streams audio/mpeg (verified >1KB real bytes; sample 'Dobrý deň, som Jarvis' generated ~24KB MP3). Caching: identical (text,voice,speed) hits SHA256 cache and returns same key deterministically. Empty text and whitespace-only text both → 400. Unauth POST → 401. Missing cache key mp3 → 404. Regressions: GET /auth/me (200, user_id=smoketest-user-1), GET /legal/tos (200 with bearer), GET /healing/state (200), POST /agent/chat (200, returns reply/message field) all unchanged. No changes made to any backend source file; only test file added.
action_items: None blocking — Sentient UX Fork backend contract is production-ready.

Optional: expose /api/voice/tts/{key}.mp3 as a signed URL (currently key is a public SHA256 hash — low risk since it's a pure hash of caller's own text+voice+speed, but a public listener who guesses a hash could stream someone else's cached mp3). Consider scoping cache per user_id if that ever matters.

Optional: _tts_cache is an unbounded in-memory dict. With 14-language onyx caching per phrase, it will grow. Add LRU eviction (e.g. functools.lru_cache-style with maxsize=1024) or move to Redis for horizontal scaling.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth.py:96-108 PrefIn: birth_year/biometric_enabled/wake_word_enabled correctly declared Optional[int]/Optional[bool] so partial PATCH works. ✓

routes/auth.py:113 upd dict comprehension `{k:v for k,v in body.model_dump().items() if v is not None}` correctly implements partial update — booleans False are preserved (not None), only unset fields skipped. ✓
routes/auth.py:114-119 birth_year range check 1900..2030 uses 400 HTTPException — matches spec. Cast to int() is safe because Pydantic already coerced to Optional[int].

routes/health.py:299-322 TTS: voice is a free-form string field defaulting to 'nova' — 'onyx' passes through untouched to OpenAI TTS. Cache key includes voice+speed+text hash so onyx and nova produce distinct entries. ✓
routes/health.py:314 cache key uses text+voice+speed+tts-1+mp3 — deterministic across calls. Verified in test_tts_caching_deterministic_key.

routes/health.py:290-295 clean_for_tts strips URLs/markdown/whitespace and truncates to 4000 chars; empty result → 400. Whitespace-only input correctly rejected (test_tts_empty_after_clean_400 passes).
